title: Hearty Ukrainian Fish Bowl
description: A pungent and juicy Ukrainian dish featuring fish seasoning, served in a Korean brass bowl, evoking nostalgic feelings with its rich flavors and aromas, and is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Korean brass bowl, mix together the fish seasoning, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cod fish to the bowl and coat it evenly with the seasoning mixture.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the bowl, arranging them around the fish.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the fish and vegetables.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh dill over the top of the fish and vegetables.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
